SessionStart.powershellCommand: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 "${pluginRoot}/hooks/llm_wiki_session.py" hook --harness copilot --if-enabled } else { python "${pluginRoot}/hooks/llm_wiki_session.py" hook --harness copilot --if-enabled }

PostToolUse.powershellCommand: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 "${pluginRoot}/hooks/llm_wiki_session.py" hook --harness copilot --if-enabled --suppress-output } else { python "${pluginRoot}/hooks/llm_wiki_session.py" hook --harness copilot --if-enabled --suppress-output }

Stop.powershellCommand: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 "${pluginRoot}/hooks/llm_wiki_session.py" hook --harness copilot --if-enabled --suppress-output } else { python "${pluginRoot}/hooks/llm_wiki_session.py" hook --harness copilot --if-enabled --suppress-output }
